immutable_rules: An escalation is a request for human review, never permission to act.
The Committee may not rewrite source code, purchase data, weaken hard risk controls, connect live brokerage authority, or place real-money orders.
Risk-control review requires a documented counterfactual test and explicit human approval.
Real-money readiness requires additional legal, tax, broker, security, operational, and human suitability review outside the paper system.
